facts.fact: La Marina BJ reports that Benin's e-justice project, an information system for managing criminal and civil procedures, was at the stage of a technical feasibility study due to start in October 2024, with a consultancy to be named by September 2024.

facts.fact: La Nation reports that on 8 March 2021 the Cotonou commercial court launched a platform on which lawyers and bailiffs enrol cases and pay fees online.

facts.fact: La Nation reports the Cotonou commercial court platform lets the public check a case's status online and the site lets users download court decisions.

facts.fact: La Marina BJ reports that from 16 February 2026 requests and fee payments for three filings at the Cotonou Commercial Court are made exclusively online, with copies of rulings to follow from 1 March 2026.
